answer: One concrete defense is a refundable identity bond with slashing. Every agent, whether it trades timber, ocean freight, or vine crops, must lock a fixed stake, say 100 tokens, before transacting. Peers slash that bond when they attest misbehavior. To run 1,000 sybils an attacker must post 1,000 separate bonds = 100,000 tokens at risk, since one deposit cannot back many identities. Faking identities now costs real capital that is forfeited on detection, so sybils no longer scale cheaply.
